name: ClipDrop
tagline: ClipDrop is a suite of AI-powered image tools by Stability AI covering background removal, image upscaling, relighting, uncropping, and text-to-image generation via Stable Diffusion. Its most popular standalone tool lets you photograph an object on any background and instantly extract it as a clean cutout. Designers and marketing teams use ClipDrop as a lightweight, fast alternative to running Photoshop for routine image tasks.
